address: Nieuwe Achtergracht 127 (Roeterseilandcampus, University of Amsterdam), Amsterdam-Centrum: campus complex of 1932 brick lecture and laboratory wings with a cream curved Roeterstraat front and 1990s-2010s glass-and-steel extensions, a dark glazed tower overhead
notes: Nieuwe Achtergracht 127 (BAG pand 0363100012185420, built 1990 in the BAG record, 672 3DBAG wall surfaces, 14,908 m2, roof max 59.2 m): the Roeterseilandcampus of the University of Amsterdam merged into one pand: 1930s brick lecture and laboratory wings round courtyards (the south wing on the Nieuwe Achtergracht with salmon-red sun blinds, the east wing with a chimney), the cream stone-and-glass-block building on the Roetersstraat, a light grey-clad extension on the north canal, a glass curtain-wall podium and a dark ribbed glazed tower over the Nieuwe Achtergracht. Eight walls were photographed; the UvA Talks sign appears on w08-253. Three fronts are drawn: the south canal wing (w03-163, 2021-01-22), the cream Roetersstraat front (w01-280, 2020-04-29) and the grey north extension (w07-343, 2017-07-06).

walls[0] = panel 173 (S, 70.7 m, eaves 12.2): four storeys of brown brick with paired windows behind salmon-red blinds and a low basement band, drawn as 4 storeys x 14 bays with string courses. walls[1] = panel 407 (W, 64 m, eaves 15.2, surface 465): the cream stone-clad Roetersstraat front with large steel-framed windows and glass-block panels, drawn as 4 storeys x 9 bays with dark frames. walls[2] = panel 107 (N, 51 m, eaves 12.2, surface 110): light grey panel cladding with teal-framed horizontal windows, 4 storeys x 10 bays.

Simplified: the salmon-red blinds are the window panes, the glass-block panels and the roof lantern strip of the cream front are not modelled, the grey cladding joints are flat colour. Not drawn: the glass curtain-wall podium and dark tower faces (w04-343, w02-253, w06-73, w08-253; the layered curtain wall would add thousands of triangles over the 12k budget), the chimney wing (w05-30), the courtyards and the other 600 surfaces, which stay blank brick on the 3DBAG shell. This is a minimal pass on a campus: most of the pand is unmodelled facade.
